mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, which metabolizes tyramine and other amines; ferrous sulfate may potentiate sympathomimetic effects through increased norepinephrine availability and can cause GI irritation that may complicate MAOI therapy.
action: Monitor for hypertensive episodes and serotonergic symptoms; ensure ferrous sulfate is taken with food away from MAOI dosing; counsel patient on tyramine-restricted diet compliance while on this combination.
